verdict.rationale: Firebase documents Cloud Functions as a serverless framework that automatically runs backend code in response to background events, and explicitly names Firebase Authentication triggers among supported event sources (with blocking functions available via Identity Platform). The Local Emulator Suite also covers Cloud Functions for local testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Firestore/Realtime Database triggers (only implied by "various Firebase features"), trigger configuration details, and independent hands-on corroboration of event-triggered functions.
